## Lesson Overview
- **Topic:** Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
- **Grade:** Grade 12
- **Subject:** Biology
- **Duration:** 40-45 minutes
- **CBSE Unit:** Biology Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

## Learning Objectives
By the end of this lesson, students will be able to:
1. Explain the role of apomixis.
2. Explain the role of polyembryony.
3. Explain the role of why apomixis matters for agriculture.

I can explain the role of apomixis.

I can explain the role of why apomixis matters for agriculture.

## Prerequisites
Students should already know:
- Concepts and vocabulary introduced earlier in this unit of Biology.
- Basic terms relevant to Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants covered in previous lessons.

## Materials & Resources
- NCERT Textbook Grade 12 Biology
- Blackboard / Whiteboard
- Notebook for worked examples and quick notes

## Homework Assignment
- Practice one more example similar to today's lesson on Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants, showing your reasoning steps.
